title: Dark mode for message body failed
creator: siffemoz
content:
Dark mode for the message body failed all of of a sudden.

- theme is set to dark - it works

- message view theme is set to dark - header is dark, body is light

- composer theme is set to dark - it works

Light theme works properly everywhere. I tried clearing cache, uninstalled/reinstalled, imported saved settings.
